title: Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri Secret Project: The Planetary Datalinks
summary: The secret project cutscene for The Planetary Datalinks from Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri, featuring a quote about free information flow as the safeguard against tyranny.
why: Quoted in privacy and surveillance debates, and praised as some of the best science fiction writing in games.

quote.text: The special projects videos in that game are some of the best science fiction creative work ever made, IMO.
